name: The Ultimate Net Worth & Smart Budget Vault (2026 Edition)
tagline: The all-in-one private wealth dashboard, 50/30/20 cash flow engine, and Federal Reserve percentile benchmark for Google Sheets & Excel.

features.title: ⚡ 2-Minute Monthly Quick-Check
features.desc: No tedious receipt typing or accounting homework. Enter just 4 numbers on the 1st of each month (Cash, Invested, Property, Debt) and let formulas do all the heavy lifting.

features.title: 💸 Smart 50/30/20 Cash Flow & Guilt-Free Buffer
features.desc: Answers the single most important question: 'How much can I safely spend right now without hurting my future?' Calculates your real-time daily spending allowance.

features.title: 🎯 Sinking Funds Shield
features.desc: Solves the #1 reason budgets fail. Automatically plans for annual car repairs, insurance renewals, holiday gifts, and emergency reserves so unexpected bills never shock your savings.

features.title: 📊 Executive Bloomberg-Style Wealth Dashboard
features.desc: Institutional dark-mode terminal layout featuring Total Net Worth, Liquid Invested Ratio, Month-over-Month deltas, and automated Federal Reserve SCF percentile rankings.

features.title: 🔥 FIRE Freedom & Retirement Engine
features.desc: Calculates your Lean FIRE, Standard FIRE (Trinity Study 4% Rule), Fat FIRE, and Coast FIRE numbers with an automated retirement calendar countdown.

features.title: 💳 Mathematical Debt Avalanche vs. Snowball
features.desc: Compares interest-minimizing Avalanche vs. psychological momentum Snowball payoff schedules to get debt-free faster.

features.title: 🔒 100% Offline & Private
features.desc: Never link sensitive bank passwords or share financial data with third-party aggregators. Runs completely on your personal device.
